siteHeader.$description: Stroke width of the line under the site header (BR-13). TBD-11: "thick" has no values; this follows a placeholder, not a brand value.

bg.$description: Fill of the site header: the pure black page, fully opaque (BR-03). The header is separated from the page by its line, not by a surface color (C-05).

line.$description: Color of the line under the site header: brand pink, like the card outline (BR-01, ADR-0018). Chosen by the owner in ADR-0030.

fg.$description: Text in the site header, such as the title. TBD-04: the body text color is not decided; this follows a placeholder, not a brand value.
